title: Ceiling Fan Vision
description: A man with long dark hair and a beard looks upward from the bottom of the frame toward a spinning ceiling fan with illuminated lights. The ceiling and walls are covered in swirling, ethereal pastel light trails, glowing particles, and dreamlike painted patterns in yellow, pink, and blue hues.
prompt: A low angle view of a man with shoulder-length dark hair and a full beard standing in a room, looking up at a spinning wooden ceiling fan with lights on. The entire ceiling and upper walls are alive with swirling, glowing pastel energy trails in pink, yellow, and cyan, sparkling particles and soft painted cloud textures creating a magical atmosphere, visible window with sheer curtains on the right, painterly style with visible brushwork
